授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: This course will pick up where we left at Linear Algebra III and we will advance further into the world of linear algebra. The main topics that we cover are orthogonality, vector spaces, linear transformations and singular value decomposition. As in Linear Algebra III this course will be theoretically oriented, however whenever  time permits we will look into interesting applications of linear algebra. One of the main objectives of the course is to develop and strengthen the ability to work with abstract objects.

The main topics that we cover are orthogonality, vector spaces, linear transformations and singular value decomposition. 授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: orthogonality, vector spaces, linear transformation, kernel and range, isomorphisms of vector spaces, singular value decomposition,  pseudoinverse
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
personal computer, knowledge from Linear Algebra I, II, III
We will use what you have learned in Linear Algebra I, II, III as a tool in this course. Make sure to review and be ready to apply what you have learned during those courses.
Students who wish to retake this course (got C or F grades in the previous years)  are required to create a detailed study plan and have it approved by the instructor before the start of the course.
